about_the_game:
Day and Night: Oath of Light and Shadow

A Live-Action Interactive Crime Story Game

A Groundbreaking Immersive Experience Breaking the Boundaries Between Film and Game.

Game Overview

When the camera turns to you, you become the key to the truth.

This is not just a game — it’s a cinematic crime thriller where you are the lead actor.
Officially licensed from “Day and Night”, this title introduces a revolutionary “Live-Action Interactive Movie + 3D Free Exploration” format, bringing you a completely new level of immersion.

Set in a parallel world, you are no longer a spectator. As a pivotal character, you’ll step into a deadly web of truth and deception — portrayed by the original cast of the series.
Every decision you make will reshape the fates of Guan Hongfeng, Guan Hongyu, Zhou Xun, and everyone involved.

Remember: on the scale of truth, your choices hold the ultimate weight.

Key Features

 Live-Action Interactive Movie – Immerse Yourself in a Crime Thriller

  • Starring the beloved original cast, filmed in cinematic, high-definition visuals, delivering tension and realism you can almost touch.

  • Engage in real-time interactions with the characters — your suspicion, empathy, or betrayal will elicit authentic emotional reactions from the actors themselves.

3D Free Investigation – Step Into the Mind of a Detective

  • Break the limits of traditional FMV games! Explore fully 3D environments to uncover every clue.

  • Move freely through crime scenes, collect evidence with your own hands, and analyze findings at professional investigation stations — from the macro scene layout to microscopic traces, every detail awaits your discovery.

 Dynamic Narrative Web – Every Choice Is Your Script

  • Built on a massive branching narrative system far more intricate than the original series.

  • Every tone of voice, every life-or-death decision, triggers a butterfly effect that reshapes the entire story.

  • Unlock dozens of unique endings — each player will reach a singular, irreversible truth.

⚖ Dual Protagonist Perspective – Between Logic and Instinct

  • Deeply rooted in the IP’s core setting, seamlessly switch between Guan Hongfeng’s analytical reasoning and Guan Hongyu’s bold instincts.

  • Experience the story from two contrasting yet intertwined perspectives — logic and emotion, light and shadow.

Coming Soon

A suspense thriller you can touch, alter, and define with your own hands.
Planned Release: 2027

Add to your wishlist now — and get ready when the curtain rises.

Business Contact

756706878@qq.com

The camera is rolling. Act now.
Every decision you make shapes your own version of “Day and Night.”
